title: Woodland Scene 7 — Before the Rain
purpose: Weather-linked sequencing and discussion about what animals do before the rain comes.

sentenceModels: The squirrel is carrying acorns to the tree hole.
The deer is looking at the sky.
The rabbit is running to the burrow.
The fox is going under the bush.
The owl is waiting on the branch.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about changing weather and what each animal might do before the rain starts.
starterPrompts: Why is the rabbit going to the burrow?
What is the deer looking at?
What can you see in the sky?
expansionPrompts: What might happen next when the rain comes?
Can you tell the story from left to right?

visualAudit: One squirrel carrying acorns to a tree hole on the left.
One deer standing in the middle looking up at the sky.
One rabbit hopping toward a burrow.
One fox moving under a bush on the right.
One owl on a branch with sunny sky on the left and dark clouds on the right.
